text.p: Here are the highlights of stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- The National Bank of Macedonia bought $13.7 million from exchange offices and $4.5 million from commercial banks in just 20 days after denar devaluation.

- Yugoslav ambassador to Skopje Zoran Janackovic handed an invitation to the Macedonian parliament chairman Tito Petkovski from the Serbian Parliament Speaker Dragan Tomic for sending republic's monitors to upcoming presidental and parliamentary elections in Serbia on September 21.

- According to the marketing agency Market Vizija and the TV station Telma opinion poll, 28 percent of 1,468 polled said VMRO-DPMNE was their favourite party, 22 percent supported Liberal Democratic Party, 18 percent said supports SDSM and 13 percent voted for the Socialists.
- The ethnic Albanian Republican Party announced integration with another ethnic Albanian party DPA at the congress called for August 15. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom 389 91 201 196
